notes: WP-F (15-WPF-as-seen.md): the page measured as the reader sees it. Counts measured in Edge with the
master's theme fonts forced (Calibri / Calibri Light); re-taken after the rebase onto B (plan D14), under
master brief §11 as B amends it: unchanged (every block here is out of flow or one paragraph run).
Labels: 4 text elements (A, B, C, D), each an absolutely positioned block of its own.
A: 4 card shapes + 4 card texts (2 paragraphs each), the dot (shape), the reveal (shape + text) —
all at rest: settle reports 6 animations, 5 at their end state, 1 looping one cancelled. 6 shapes, 5 texts.
B: the svg's #FF4136 rect is a native shape; its foreignObject is the one raster. 1 shape, 1 raster.
C: a multicol block yields one text element per column box that received a line, in column order:
'.cols' (2 columns, one paragraph) is 2 texts; '.cols3' (3 columns, two paragraphs, the first straddling
a break) is 3 texts — the straddling paragraph is one paragraph in each of the first two. 5 texts.
D: each of the four clipped/clamped blocks is 1 text element holding only what the reader sees, and each
is an error diagnostic starting 'text is clipped' (every error this family produces is that one). 4 texts.
Totals: text 4 + 5 + 5 + 4 = 18; shape 6 + 1 (the 4 card fills, dot, reveal; the svg rect) = 7; raster 1.

gateMaxPx2 60 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 0 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
